violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §747.2311(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: The substitute caregiver placed a child in play yard with no mattress. There was cardboard and board of wood under the sheet. The play yard did not have manufactures mattress.

finding_variants.text: The substitute caregiver placed a child in play yard with no mattress. There was cardboard and board of wood under the sheet. The play yard did not have manufactures mattress.

According to manufacturers guidelines, a child shoud be 35 inches, 30 pounds, and unable to climb out. A child was observed using the pack and play that was outside the manufacturer guidelines. This was corrected at inspection when the child was removed from the pack and play.
During nap time the play yards were covered with blankets on the sides blocking inside and outside view.This was corrected at inspection by removing the blankets.
The play yard had holes on the fabric that was underneath the mat measuring one to two inches.
The play yards had debris under the mattresses which appeared to be food. The play yards were removed during the inspection. The play yard kept up was cleaned.
A play yard observed in the livingroom was observed unsanitary with holes observed on the mesh sides of the playyard.
